cards.prompt:
Create ONE finished Chinese LANDSCAPE promotional banner for a REAL casual MINI-GAME COLLECTION. Strict HORIZONTAL 16:9 canvas, ideally 2560×1440 pixels, full bleed, intended for a recommendation banner as small as 320×180. This needs a new landscape composition, not a portrait poster cropped into landscape.
LAYOUT: Left approximately 35 percent is a calm uncluttered typography area. Right approximately 60 percent holds exactly FOUR equally weighted complete game scenes in a balanced 2×2 arrangement; none is a hero game or a tiny extra icon. Leave a narrow soft visual seam between text and illustrations. All four scenes have comparable area and visual priority. Entire subjects stay inside their game window, away from text. Keep all important objects and every text line at least 4–5 percent inside full image edges.
TYPE HIERARCHY: Small but bold brand "随手玩一把" near upper-left within the text area. Under brand, a very large bold rounded Chinese headline on EXACTLY TWO lines as supplied below. Below the headline, the smaller line "休闲小游戏合集". No other writing, no labels on individual scenes. Strong clean type at thumbnail size; avoid thick multicolored text outlines. The left text and right game worlds should feel integrated, like professionally art-directed casual-game key art.
MEOWDOKU REFERENCE: A supporting image is an actual cat puzzle gameplay screenshot. Use ONLY its white-framed colored-region puzzle board with tiny ragdoll CAT-HEAD tokens and white X marks. Ignore its entire screenshot UI, score, hearts, controls and labels. Show a modest simplified 6×6 pastel connected-region board with roughly four tiny cat-head tokens and some white X marks, all cat tokens in different rows and columns and not touching diagonally. Empty cells remain. No numbers on the cat board. It is only ONE equal game scene. ALL cats remain small tokens INSIDE the board; no full-body kitten, no big external cat face or central mascot.
STRICT USER EXCLUSIONS: NO bubble-shooter, bubble cannon, bubble boss characters or floating bubble decorations; NO Chinese or western chess or chess pieces; NO watermelon, fruit-merging imagery or fruit decorations. No phone/app mockups, game controls, scores, fake buttons, prices, QR codes, external brand symbols, logos or watermarks. Only supplied text. Each right-side game scene stays wholly within its equal quadrant.
ART DIRECTION: Fresh sunny sky-blue, warm ivory, pale peach and lilac. Left calm blue sky with very soft cloud puffs near the lower edge. Right four equal game-world areas separated by gentle cream cloud-shaped curves, not heavy hard frames. Bright airy illustration with crisp large subjects and very restrained sparkles, lots of breathing room. Palette matches an inviting light-blue portrait campaign.
TEXT: Brand and other type dark navy. Left headline first line exactly "多种玩法", second line exactly "随心切换". Supporting line exactly "休闲小游戏合集", brand exactly "随手玩一把".
RIGHT TOP LEFT / ref1: ivory modular skyscraper with blue window pairs, yellow crane suspending its next floor with a visible small gap. Miniature tall tower fully within its quadrant with pale city and peach clouds.
RIGHT TOP RIGHT / ref2: cyan center ring interlinked with open pink, purple, lime C-rings, one orange C-ring rotating free. Rounded broad gaps, small colored cuffs, clean glossy shapes, local cream/lilac backdrop.
RIGHT BOTTOM LEFT / ref3: compact white-framed 6×6 colored-region cat puzzle with small cat-head tokens and white X marks as specified. Same visual area as the fill board opposite it, no cat outside board.
RIGHT BOTTOM RIGHT / ref4: dark slate 4×4 rounded-square route-fill board, coral/turquoise/blue/yellow cell regions, darker thick same-color paths taking 90-degree turns, clear circular endpoints, no hand.
No extra props, no giant central character, no big fruit, the message is four different fun mini-games.
